texts.preamble: Ashok Kumar vs J&K; Govt. Health Department And Ors. on 26 October, 2018 Author: Sanjay Kumar Gupta Bench: Sanjay Kumar Gupta High Court Of Jammu And Kashmir At Jammu Crmc No. 55/2012, Ia No.66/2012 Date of order: 26.10.2018 Ashok Kumar vs J&K Govt. Health Department and ors.
texts.facts: The trial CRMA No. 55/2012 Page 1 Court took cognizance and issued notice to the aforesaid respondents. On 03.02.2010, respondent no. 2-Jeewan Singh appeared however; respondent No. 3-Managing Ashok Kumar vs JK Govt. Health Department And Ors. on 26 October, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107211438/ 1 Director, Shalimar Industries did not appear before the Trial Court. Accordingly, process was issued against respondent No. 3-Managing Director, Shalimar Industries. It is worthwhile, to mention here that in the above said complaint name of respondent No. 3 herein has not been mentioned only Managing Director, Shalimar Industries, SICOP Complex, Birpur, Bari Brahmana, Jammu has been written. 4. It appears that an address of One Sunil Baru as accused no.2 was provided by complainant vide application dated 9.12.2009 and 24.02.2010; on which trial Court directed issuance of non-bailable warrants against respondent Managing Director .The order dated 22.12.2010 would reveal that Sunil Baru appeared before the trial Court as respondent -Managing Director Shalimar Industries, SICOP Complex, Birpur, Bari Brahmana, Jammu in compliance to warrant and filed an application for dropping the proceedings through his counsel, on the ground that he is not the Managing Director of Shalimar Industries and presently posted as Project operator at Mubark Mandi; that the complainant has provided wrong address of accused No. 2. 5. The Trial Court did not pass any speaking order on the said application; however, on the of statement of complainant, that he has no objection and correct name of accused was Ashok Kumar (petitioner-herein) , the court issued bailable warrant against the petitioner. Court below thus has issued bailable warrant of Rs, 10,000/- without authenticating the fact, as to whether petitioner was actually Managing Director or not. Even otherwise, procedural law demands that Magistrates was to issue summon at first instance, because calling a person especially a high ranking officer by issuing warrant to face a criminal trial, amounts to disgrace. Order dated 2.9.2011,would reveal that Wassem Showkat, Advocate appeared before court and undertook to produce the CRMA No. 55/2012 Page 2 accused no.2 before court on next date on 15.10.2011 . It is also mention here that Wassem Showkat, Advocate has filed vakalatnama for Sunil Baru and not for the petitioner. But, the court thereafter on 15.10.2011 court issued non- bailable warrant against the petitioner and continuously thereafter and lastly on 01.3.2012 .This Court vide order dated 01.03.2012, while entertaining the petition, has already stayed the execution of the warrant issued against the petitioner.
